snippet.title: K-POP RISING – DREAM TO SHINE | Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
Vibe to the rhythm of the global phenomenon in K-POP Rising - Dream to Shine! 🎤 Become the new Korean pop sensation starting November 5th, 2026 on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC (Steam).

Add the game to your Wishlist now!

Together with your best friend Nova, make your mark in the world of K-pop! Throw yourself into the race for fame and let your talent sparkle, from the practice rooms to the world's biggest stages. Developed by Old Skull Games and published by Microids, this ultimate simulation and rhythm game lets you build your dream group, customize your style, and grow your global community to rule the charts. 🌟

KEY FEATURES:
👑 Your group, your rules: Create a group in your own image, recruit its members, and turn your very first fans into an international community of millions of followers.
💃 Keep up the pace: Fine-tune your singing, master highly precise choreographies, and sharpen your rhythm through captivating gameplay phases.
👗 An adventure that suits you: Express your uniqueness! Create and customize your character from head to toe with trendy outfits and iconic K-Pop star makeup.
👥 Shine solo, triumph as a trio: Experience the adventure on your own or team up with 2 friends in co-op mode to lead your girl group straight to the top!

"Music is your universe, passion is your fuel: the future of K-Pop is you!"

GAME SPECS:
• Release Date: November 5, 2026
• Platforms: Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PC (Steam)
• Genre: Simulation / Rhythm game / Music
• Players: 1-3 players (Solo & Co-op)
• Developer: Old Skull Games
• Publisher: Microids

Website: https://www.microids.com/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Microids_off
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/microids/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/microids_official/
